description: Returns the JSON Schema for the input to ifr_calculate for a given standard. Use this to discover required fields, enum values, and defaults without calling ifr_schema. Returns a standard JSON Schema object suitable for programmatic validation. Derived from the controller FIELD_DEFINITIONS — always reflects the current engine version. FREE — no usage charge.

assetClass.description: Discriminator when elementType is "asset" — e.g. PPE, INTANGIBLE_ASSET, INVESTMENT_PROPERTY, BIOLOGICAL_ASSET, EXPLORATION (IAS 16 subclass values also route).

investmentType.description: Discriminator when elementType is "equity-method-investment" — ASSOCIATE or JOINT_VENTURE.

name: ifr_input_schema
